Impinj | Hybrid in Seattle, WA | Intern (Summer 2026) | https://www.impinj.com/

Impinj is a leading RAIN RFID provider connecting everyday physical items — retail apparel, healthcare supplies, airline baggage, auto parts — to the Internet. Over 100 billion items connected and counting.

We're hiring a software engineering intern to own a lighthouse initiative, working closely with an experienced mentor, Product Management, and the SVP of Engineering to design and build a proof-of-concept edge compute runtime that has the power to shape our product roadmap.

We're looking for someone passionate about software development and great user experience, who brings real energy to hard problems — overcoming obstacles, collaborating across disciplines, and getting things done.

If this sounds like an exciting challenge you're well qualified for, please apply here: https://grnh.se/gnvrob3z5us
